feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 June 2026 5:28pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 01 June 2026 at 5:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of the British Isles as various frontal zones affect the area.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 2 to 4 later this evening, occasionally 5 in the southeast of the area. Veering mainly west or southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle with mist and fog patches, clearing to rain and showers later tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches. Occasionally moderate or poor in rain and showers tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the south, backing south or southeast 4 to 6 on Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers, then rain from Wednesday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
